title: Yellow Braised Portuguese Seitan Burger
description: A vegan friendly Portuguese dish featuring a fatty and velvety seitan burger, served on a sesame seed bun. It is a perfect lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the seitan and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the port wine, vegetable broth, tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
While the seitan is cooking, toast the sesame seed buns.
Assemble the burgers by placing the cooked seitan on the toasted buns.
Serve the burgers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the burgers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
